title: Robotic Operation, Behavior, and Interaction in Medicine
summary: In the study, people who work in the healthcare sector are surveyed using questionnaires. They are asked to indicate which type of interaction with robots they prefer in various situations presented in the workshop. To do this, they choose between opposing pairs of words that describe certain characteristics of the robots.
conditions: Suitability of different concepts of robotic systems close to the staff and patient is being investigated

interventions.name: The study population is not divided and consists of medical personnel, for example from the group of doctors, nurses, physiotherapists or personnel who are still in training or studying. criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
All participants are medical professionals (e.g. doctors, nursing assistants, medical students) who are employed in a hospital or other medical facility before or during the study.
Experience in the relevant field
Sufficient knowledge of German to enable an understanding of the study content and instructions from the scientific staff.
Existing consent to the study.
Exclusion criteria:
Participants have no medical experience or connection to healthcare facilities at the time of the study.
Lack of consent.
Inability/limitation of the German language.
